Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.

On April 10, 2024, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Industrials Group Inc. (the "Company") accepted the resignation of David Williams as President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective April 30, 2024. Mr. Williams has served as CEO since January 2018.

The Board has appointed Sarah Johnson, currently the Company's Chief Operating Officer, as President and Chief Executive Officer effective May 1, 2024. Ms. Johnson, age 52, joined the Company in 2015 and has served as Chief Operating Officer since March 2021. Prior to that, she served as Executive Vice President of Operations from 2015 to 2021.

In connection with Ms. Johnson's appointment, the Compensation Committee of the Board approved the following compensation package: (i) an annual base salary of $1,200,000; (ii) target annual cash incentive opportunity of 125% of base salary; and (iii) annual long-term incentive award opportunity of $5,000,000 in equity awards.

Mr. Williams and the Company entered into a separation agreement providing for a lump-sum cash payment equal to 24 months of Mr. Williams' base salary ($2,400,000), continued vesting of outstanding equity awards through December 31, 2024, and continuation of health benefits for 18 months.

 

Item 7.01. Regulation FD Disclosure.

On April 12, 2024, the Company issued a press release announcing the executive leadership transition described above. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
